bio: I'm Anas, a multimedia designer based in Dubai. I work across graphic design, 3D, motion and video, and I like owning a piece of work from the idea to the final file.

Today I lead creative and video production at MangoBot, a company building AI and humanoid robots. When I joined, the company had a logo and nothing else. I built the brand identity, the first website and the in-house video production, and I now direct, film and edit the company's videos.
Before that I spent two years at Promate Technologies, where I taught myself Blender and turned it into a core part of how I work. Outside of client work, I'm writing and producing my own short film.
